'''Chapter 1000''' is titled "Straw Hat Luffy".

==Cover Page==
[[Cover Page#Color Spread|Color Spread]]: Shows the second half of the poster celebrating the 1000th chapter of the series. This half shows some of the [[Straw Hat Pirates]]; [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]], [[Nami]], and [[Jinbe]], as well as part of [[Brook]], [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]], and [[Nico Robin|Robin]] (which the other part is connected with the cover page of the [[Chapter 999|previous chapter]]). They are enjoying a big treasure party.

==Short Summary==
As the [[Inuarashi Musketeer Squad]] clears [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]]'s way to the roof and [[Polo Marco|Marco]] throws [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] up there, [[Yamato]] reminisces about meeting with [[Portgas D. Ace|Ace]]. Ace had revealed Luffy's dream to Yamato, who had read those exact words in [[Kouzuki Oden]]'s logbook quoting the Pirate King [[Gol D. Roger|Roger]]. Before Ace departed, Yamato made him a [[Vivre Card]] so they could find each other again someday, but Yamato's portion of the card disappeared once Ace died. Back in the present, Yamato reveals to [[Kouzuki Momonosuke|Momonosuke]] that Oden wrote in his logbook that if he did not survive, then powerful pirates leading a new [[Worst Generation|generation]] would come into the New World and take down [[Kaidou]] in 20 years.

As Yamato recounts this, Luffy, Zoro, [[Trafalgar D. Water Law|Law]], [[Eustass Kid|Kid]], and [[Killer]] confront Kaidou and [[Charlotte Linlin|Big Mom]] on the Skull Dome's roof. Luffy goes to talk to [[Kin'emon]], who has been defeated along with the other [[Nine Red Scabbards]], and the samurai asks Luffy to put Wano on his back in the light of his own group's failure. As Kaidou moves to attack them, Luffy has Law move the Scabbards inside the Skull Dome while he leaps over Kaidou. He then proceeds to strike the Emperor in the face with ''Gomu Gomu no Red Roc'', a powerful [[Gomu Gomu no Mi/Gear 3 Techniques|Gear 3]] punch that sends him crashing to the ground. Luffy then tells Kaidou and Big Mom that he is the one who will surpass them and become the Pirate King.

==Long Summary==
Finally reaching the fifth floor, [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] comes across the [[Inuarashi Musketeer Squad]], who have cleared the way to the roof and ask him to continue onwards. Luffy thanks [[Shishilian]] and makes his way to the roof, while also telling all of them that he remembers how they defended [[Raizo]] with their lives, which causes Shishilian to tear up. On the Live Floor, [[Polo Marco|Marco]] uses his flames to hold [[Queen]] (who is shown to have a mechanical elongated neck) and [[King]] back while he throws [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] up to the roof, much to his chagrin though.

In the storage room, [[Yamato]] returns [[Kouzuki Oden|Oden]]'s journal to [[Kouzuki Momonosuke|Momonosuke]], revealing he had believed he had died twenty years ago, and he never expected a day he could meet him. Yamato also reveals he found the journal near the river at the foot of Oden's Castle that day long ago and says that someone must have protected it, since it has written about his life and time traveling the world. Yamato asks if Momonosuke was born on [[Edward Newgate|Whitebeard]]'s ship and he even sailed on [[Gol D. Roger|Roger]]'s ship and explains that Oden and the [[Roger Pirates]] predicted that a little over twenty years in the future, a new generation of pirates would advance to the [[New World]], and he believe they were talking about this very moment. Yamato also revealed that he thought [[Portgas D. Ace|Ace]] would have led the charge but after his death he recalled something.

In the past, Ace accidentally told Yamato about Luffy and his dream before demanding he never laugh at him. He declares he won't allow anyone to mock his dreams because he and [[Sabo]] believed in him. Before he can finish, Yamato starts tearing up and declares he would never laugh at him, because those were the same words that dumbfounded Oden. Ace is intrigued by who said that and offers to drink with that person and Luffy someday, only for Yamato to reveal that person was dead, which annoys him. Afterwards Yamato gives Ace his [[Vivre Card]], who explains to him how it functions and asks to meet him again someday, which he agrees to.

In the present, Yamato reveals that Ace's Vivre Card disappeared without a trace one day, which made him realize he was dead, and the newspaper the next day revealed everything, such as Ace being Roger's son and that Luffy was already making a name for himself. Yamato explains that Momonosuke brought that very same person to [[Wano Country|Wano]], as if Oden documented the future, and how a group of powerful pirates would shoulder the burden of the next era and go to the New World, and by chance he died, they would defeat [[Kaidou]] in his stead.

Speaking of, Luffy and Zoro reach the roof of the Skull Dome along with [[Eustass Kid]], [[Killer]], and [[Trafalgar D. Water Law|Law]] where they confront Kaidou and [[Charlotte Linlin|Big Mom]] awaiting them. Luffy notices something and starts walking toward the two as Kaidou tells Big Mom what Luffy told him previously. Big Mom also adds how he talked back at her and how he destroyed her castle, so she wants an apology. To their surprise though, Luffy ignores them and walks past them over to the [[Nine Red Scabbards]] and [[Izou]], who were defeated and left beaten on the floor. Kaidou turns to look at Luffy and demands he say what he said to them previously to their faces. Luffy, however, continues to ignore them and apologize to [[Kin'emon]] for arriving late. He looks at the injured samurai as Kin'emon distraughtly says that he can't leave things as they are, or he will never be able to face Oden in the afterlife. He asks Luffy to shoulder their burden and save Wano, who agrees citing that it is the land of his friends.

An annoyed Kaidou proceeds to raise his club to strike Luffy, who asks Law to move everyone away with his [[Ope Ope no Mi|Devil Fruit]] powers, which he does so. He then jumps high into the air dodging Kaidou's strike as he goes into '''Gear 3'''. As he does so, he thinks back to when the [[Mink Tribe]] revealed that Raizo was safe and that they would never sell out their allies, Momonosuke's tears as he yelled, he wanted to take down Kaidou, Kin'emon revealing he had traveled through time, [[Shimotsuki Yasuie|Yasuie]]'s execution, [[Hyougoro]]'s tears of joy, and Kin'emon revealing the details of Oden's death. He then proceeds to strike Kaidou with a new attack called '''[[Gomu Gomu no Mi/Gear 3 Techniques#Post-Timeskip|Gomu Gomu no Red Roc]]''', slamming him into the ground and actually causing him to bleed. Big Mom is left in disbelief at the sight of Kaidou getting knocked down as Luffy introduces himself as the one who will surpass the two of them and become the Pirate King.

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*Ace reveals Luffy's true dream to Yamato, who reveals it's the same one as Gol D. Roger's as written in Oden's logbook.
*The [[Mink Tribe]] recovers from their battle with [[Jack]]'s forces and clears [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]]'s way to the roof.
*[[Polo Marco|Marco]] holds back [[King]] and [[Queen]], and throws [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] to the roof.
**Queen is revealed to have a mechanical elongated neck.
*[[Yamato]] gives [[Kouzuki Oden|Oden]]'s journal to [[Kouzuki Momonosuke|Momonosuke]].
*It is revealed that [[Portgas D. Ace|Ace]]'s [[Vivre Card]] was given to him by Yamato.
*Luffy, Zoro, [[Trafalgar D. Water Law|Law]], [[Eustass Kid|Kid]], and [[Killer]] have reached the roof and are facing [[Kaidou]] and [[Charlotte Linlin|Big Mom]].
*The [[Nine Red Scabbards|Scabbards]] and [[Izou]] are gravely wounded, but still alive.
**Law [[Ope Ope no Mi|moves]] the Scabbards away from the roof.
*Luffy strikes Kaidou with a new [[Gomu Gomu no Mi/Gear 3 Techniques|Gear 3]] attack, "Gomu Gomu no Red Roc", which actually causes Kaidou to bleed.

*Following the release of [[Chapter 990]], the official [https://twitter.com/Eiichiro_Staff Twitter] and [https://www.instagram.com/onepiece_staff/ Instagram] accounts managed by [[Eiichiro Oda]]'s staff started a countdown to Chapter 1000. The countdown features images of each [[Straw Hat Pirates]] member from their introduction, with the exception of Jinbe. The images are tinted in the featured character's [[Straw Hat Pirates/Miscellaneous#Specific Colors|thematic color]], and numbered in reverse order of joining, from Jinbe to Luffy.
**Jinbe's image is the first time his thematic color is shown.
**Luffy and Zoro's images feature the logo of "One Piece 1000 Logs".

{{Gallery|width=210|height=160|captionalign=center|position=center
|Chapter 1000 Anime.png|Luffy and Chopper announce the then-upcoming manga chapter.
|Chapters 999-1000 Full Color Spread.png|Chapter 999-1000 Full Color spread.
}}

*At the end of [[Episode 956]], Luffy and Chopper addressed the viewers to announce the then-upcoming milestone.
*To celebrate the 1,000th chapter of the series, the poster representing the Straw Hat crew for the cover page is split between [[Chapter 999]] and this chapter. The full version of this color spread was revealed on the day this chapter was released.
**As revealed by Oda in [[SBS Volume 99]], the color spreads are a commemoration of the one from [[Chapter 100]], with Luffy and Nami in the same pose as in that spread. The title font and background are also the same.
**Accordingly, in [[Volume 99]], the first page of the spread is moved to the beginning of Chapter 1000.
*Luffy's silhouette at the end of the chapter resembles [[Shanks]]' pose of removing his [[Straw Hat]] at the end of Chapter 1. As revealed in [[One Piece Magazine Vol.13]], this was coincidental; while Oda did intend on having Luffy specifically wearing the Straw Hat during his dialogue, he did not realize the similarities to Shanks' pose until after the chapter's publication.
